source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: What information should you give an agent when asking it to assemble your work into a file?

options.text: The model size and preferred editor
options.feedback: Those choices do not tell the agent what belongs in the deliverable. Specify the required contents and the output format.

options.text: The needed contents and file format
options.feedback: These instructions define what the packaged work must contain and how it should be delivered. You still need to inspect the resulting file.

options.text: The completion wording and reply length
options.feedback: These shape the agent's message about its work. They do not specify the contents of the artifact you need.

options.text: The skill title and conversation length
options.feedback: A skill title can identify guidance, but it does not replace telling the agent which materials to gather and what file format to produce.
